column7: I am an experienced Qur’an and Islamic Studies teacher with over two years of experience teaching non-Arabic-speaking Muslims in English. I have worked with several well-established academies, including Makkah Academy, Super Muslim Academy, Ruwaq Al-Quran Academy, Bedaya Academy, and Noor Al-Quran Academy, in addition to providing private lessons. I specialize in teaching Qur’an, Tajweed, Tafsir, and Islamic Studies. My lessons are engaging, structured, and tailored to each student’s level, helping them learn confidently while developing a strong connection with their faith.
column8: My teaching approach is student-centered, practical, and tailored to each learner’s level, age, and individual needs. I focus on making lessons clear, engaging, and easy to follow while encouraging students to participate actively rather than simply listen. I use a structured approach that combines explanation, practice, repetition, and regular feedback to help students make steady progress. I also create a supportive learning environment where students feel comfortable asking questions and making mistakes. My goal is not only to help students learn the Qur’an and Islamic Studies, but also to develop a deeper understanding and connection with their faith.
